title: Prove euf lemmas over folded ites without the unfolded fallback
summary: EUF theory lemmas that reach if-then-else terms now get a single grind proof with the ites folded, dropping the unused unfolded fallback under first. This halves their text and cuts the Lean check of register_file_instance(8) from about 20 s to 7 s without changing any theorem statement.
